concept.th-process.def: A running program, loaded into its own separate patch of memory.
concept.th-core.def: One worker inside the CPU; a single core does one instruction at a time.
concept.th-time-sharing.def: Giving one core to several processes in turn, switching thousands of times a second so they seem to run at once.
concept.th-scheduler.def: The part of the operating system that decides which process gets the core next.
concept.th-parallelism.def: Running things at the very same instant on more than one core.
concept.th-isolation.def: Walling each process off in its own memory so one cannot read or wreck another's, which keeps a crash contained.
